tickets.subject: Bulldog tee: 1 × CC-TEE-WHITE size S for Tauhid Zaman
tickets.outcome: Size S was out of stock and the only apparel vendor was blocked by overdue invoice 501. The $840 invoice was paid after human approval, then a 1-tee purchase order ($8) was approved and paid. The tee is due about 2026-09-05. A customer update is drafted (unsent).

agents.boss: Routed Inventory first, then Accounting, then Customer Service. Checked cash across the board, made the final call, and recorded it with update_ticket.
agents.inventory: Found 0 of 1 on hand (short 1). Matched the item to Bulldog Print Co (5 lead days). Flagged can_ship=false while invoice 501 was open, and later confirmed can_ship=true after it was paid.
agents.accounting: Queued invoice 501 ($840) for approval and did not order from the blocked vendor. After the payment, confirmed it was executed and queued a purchase order for exactly 1 tee at the $8.00 unit cost.
agents.customer_service: Saved drafts #1–#3 to Tauhid saying size S is being restocked, with no firm date and no internal details. Nothing was sent.
agents.facilities: Not called (no lease or space issue).

tickets.notes: Run 2 skipped the purchase order. The Boss and Accounting prompts were clarified, and run 3 placed it.

tickets.subject: Rent notice from Elm City Properties, lease 1
tickets.outcome: Confirmed that $2,400 rent was due 2026-09-02 (2 days after desk.date_today, not overdue). The payment was queued, approved by a human and paid. The lease's next_due moved to 2026-10-02.

agents.boss: Routed the notice to Facilities, checked cash ($2,552, leaving $152), and recorded the final call.
agents.facilities: Checked the ticket's claim against lease 1 with get_rent_status and handed the payment to Accounting.
agents.accounting: Checked cash and queued the $2,400 rent payment (amount taken from leases.monthly_rent) for approval.
agents.customer_service: Not called (the requester is the landlord).

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount: 20 × CC-HOOD-NAVY size M for Yale AI Club
tickets.outcome: Offered 10% off ($52.20 each; 57.9% margin; $604 margin on 20) with the 8 in-stock hoodies now. The 12-unit restock ($264) was declined because only $152 cash remained. An offer is drafted (unsent). No money moved.

agents.boss: Routed Inventory, then Accounting. Chose the 10% discount and the partial fill. Deferred the restock for lack of cash, and briefed Customer Service.
agents.inventory: Found 8 of 20 on hand (short 12). Confirmed Bulldog Print Co could ship (5 lead days, arriving 2026-09-05 if ordered).
agents.accounting: Priced 10%, 15% and 20% off with quote_bulk_order. Found the $264 restock exceeded the $152 cash ($112 short), so it created no purchase order.
agents.customer_service: Saved draft #4 to Yale AI Club with the $52.20 offer, 8 available now, and a question about split fulfillment. Nothing was sent.
